newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mokhzani general offer for Pantai lapses.
newsitem.headline: Mokhzani general offer for Pantai lapses.

text.p: Malaysian businessman Mokhzani Mahathir said on Saturday his takeover general offer for the shares and loan stocks in Hospital Pantai Bhd which he did not already own, has lapsed.

In a statement issued by his merchant bankers, Mokhzani said he did not receive any offer to buy additional Pantai shares or its irredeemable convertible unsecured loan stocks (ICULS) during the offer period.
His interest in health services firm Pantai remained at 56.53 percent of its issued and paid-up capital, and 4.5 percent of its ICULS.
The interest includes 21.0 percent of Pantai's equity held by Tongkah Holdings Bhd, of which Mokhzani is executive chairman and chief executive officer, and 4.5 percent of the ICULS.
Mokhzani is a son of Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.
